title: Metric stitching regression: aggregation key collision causing blank dashboard tiles
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Several customers (hosted + dedicated tenants) reported blank/zeroed dashboard tiles and intermittent missing timeseries starting 2026-03-08 03:10 UTC. Investigation shows the aggregator's metric-stitcher service began collapsing distinct ingestion keys into a deduplicated aggregation key after a schema change in the routing layer. The effect: legitimate high-cardinality metrics were deduped and dropped during rollup, leaving dashboard widgets and live panels with missing data for up to ~2 hours. Traces for some requests were still ingested but lacked correlated metric tags, causing linked trace->metric navigation to fail.
reproduction_steps: Simulate two concurrent ingestion streams (hosted and dedicated) with overlapping metric.name and disjoint tenant.tags
Trigger a routing config change that adds 'source_namespace' header to the request (mirror of production change on 2026-03-08 02:58 UTC),
Observe stitcher applying a new hash function that omits tenant tag under high throughput and dropping the event during rollup, resulting in empty aggregation buckets
investigation_notes: Checked ingestion logs: routing-change rollout at 02:58 UTC introduced header 'source_namespace' but aggregator variant did not include it in the dedupe key function
Reproducer created against staging shard-09 with load generator; confirmed 18% of series collapse when hash path omitted tenant tag
Metric-stitcher error rate spiked (500s) during rotation window; aggregator did not surface obvious exceptions because code path silently normalized the key
Affected tenants observed gap windows aligned with autoscaler shard-rotation events (03:10-03:40 UTC)
Related customer escalations: ZD-54921 (Acme Corp), ZD-54928 (NimbusAI)
quick_mitigation: 01: Roll back routing header change in canary region at 03:40 UTC -> immediate return of metric series for canary tenants
02: Temporarily pin aggregator to previous hash function for dedicated and private clusters (hotpatch rolled at 04:05 UTC)
03: Opened high-priority support threads and provided customers with temporary alert suppressions and a reconstruction ETA
proposed_fix: 1) Rework aggregator keying to include explicit ordered list of tag keys (tenant_id, source_namespace, metric.name) instead of ad-hoc hash heuristics
2) Add unit+integration tests that exercise header/metadata permutations across hosted/dedicated/private routing
3) Implement a canary gating check in the routing change pipeline that validates metric cardinality invariants before global rollout
4) Backfill job: rehydrate lost series by replaying raw ingestion buffer (buffer retention covers the 3-hour window) and re-run rollup for affected time ranges
fixes: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/aggregator/pull/2987 - fix: preserve tenant tag in dedupe key (merged 2026-03-13 09:12 UTC)
PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/4312 - add canary cardinality check (open, awaiting review)
Hotpatch: internal-hotpatch-2026-03-08-agg-revert applied to dedicated clusters (applied 2026-03-08 04:05 UTC)
rollout_plan: Stage -> region canary (2% traffic) with new keying + smoke cardinality checks
Monitor: tenant-level cardinality delta, dashboard empty-tile rate, stitcher 5xx rate for 2 hours
If stable, ramp to 10% -> 50% -> 100% across hosted and dedicated over 6 hours
Private/on-prem customers: provide patch bundle and a one-off migration script for offline backfill
test_plan: Add fuzz tests for the keying function including ordering sensitivity
Create synthetic workload with 250k unique series and assert <0.1% collapse after rollup
Add e2e scenario that performs routing header toggle while load generator is running to catch rotational races
monitoring_and_alerts: New SLO guard: 'cardinality-delta-per-tenant' with 10x sensitivity during rollouts
Dashboard: 'empty-tile-rate' heatmap per region/cluster (alert threshold 0.5% for P0)
Pager rule: escalate to oncall-obs + infra when stitcher 5xx > 0.2% for 5m
customer_communication: 03/08 05:15 UTC - initial message to impacted customers (Acme/NimbusAI) with mitigation and ETA
03/13 16:30 UTC - follow-up: patch merged, rolling back landing; offered data-replay backfill and status of backfill queue
postmortem_actions: 1. Enforce schema contract between routing and aggregator components (API-level schema + automated contract tests)
2. Add pre-deploy cardinality regression test to CI (fail builds on >2% delta for high-cardinality metrics)
3. Operational: increase ingestion buffer retention to 6 hours for hosted+dedicated during risky rollouts
4. Run one-week focused audit of sequenced shard rotations and autoscaler interactions
blockers: Backfill throughput limited by rehydration worker capacity (need temporary capacity bump)
PR ingest/pull/4312 requires design review from platform-arch team (meeting scheduled 2026-03-15)
Private/on-prem customers need an appliance-compatible backfill script; engineering needs signoff from solutions-eng
